title: Plane of Hate B — augment preview
summary: Not released: Hate B zone augment preview at the unchanged0.5% rate.
body:
Not released: Hate B regular combat mobs will roll Blackspire Prism at0.5% per eligible death in public, Grind and Raid environments. A separate layout/entry release controls access. The equipment family remains disabled. Existing original Plane of Hate retains Spiteglass Prism.

  • Blackspire Prism
  • Blackspire Prism (Polished)
  • Blackspire Prism (Exalted)
  • Blackspire Prism (Ascension)

Eligibility preview. No guaranteed drop or pity timer.
